title: Retro gaming is being overrun with AI
script:
Classic games are appearing on devices where they never belonged.
Developers are using AI to automate the complex process of code decompilation.
This allows Halo to run directly inside a standard web browser.
Wind Waker is now being ported to run on an iPhone.
Super Smash Bros is even appearing inside mixed reality headsets.
These viral projects have surged in frequency over the last thirty days.
AI tools allow projects to move from manual reverse engineering to rapid automated porting.
Would you play your childhood favorites if they were AI-ported to your phone today?

editor.one_line: Weak hook and generic visuals; lacks specific AI tool names and technical depth.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Replace with 'Retro games are being ported to modern devices at record speeds.'
LINE 2: Name the specific AI tools or research papers driving this decompilation.
LINE 3: Specify the browser or engine (e.g., 'WebAssembly-based engines') instead of 'standard web browser'.
visual_notes: line 1: Hook is text-only; needs high-energy footage of a game running on a phone.
line 5: Nintendo logo is generic; needs actual footage of Smash Bros in a headset.
line 6: Static text card is boring; needs a visual representation of the surge in projects.
